description:
PROBLEM
fz-go4.17.10 was supposed to delete-or-quarantine the legacy semantic/transport jobs so they are not ambient production vocabulary, and was closed -- but the spine is still live (it was only deferred on the interp pull path, and runs in full on the native path). Once the native cutover (this epic's earlier tickets) removes the last consumer, finish the deletion honestly.

DELETE once proven to have no non-test consumer (work consumers-backward):
- Job + match arms: SealSemanticClosure (root.rs:137), DeriveTransportPlan (transport.rs:885), DeriveExecutableTransport (transport.rs:847), DeriveRuntimeDemand (runtime_demand.rs). Remove their follow_up scheduling from seed_root (root.rs:83/365) and transport.rs:904/935.
- FactKey variants + stores: SemanticReady, SemanticClosed (drive.rs:78-79; world.rs:1244), ExecutableTransport (drive.rs:80), TransportPlan + world.transport_plan/define_transport_plan (world.rs:448/1242).
- World::root_executable_frontier (world.rs:2687) + its sole fact_keys() scan; or move strictly behind #[cfg(test)] with this ticket as the removal record.
- DumpStage::Semantic (compiler.rs:148): keep ONLY if explicitly retained as a legacy diagnostic; otherwise delete. Decide and document.
- The deferred-forever handling in the product fact-wait loops once nothing schedules the forbidden jobs (forbidden_product_path_job becomes unnecessary -- remove all copies).

SIGNAL
rg shows no production Job/FactKey/store for the legacy seal/transport spine; root_executable_frontier is absent from production; lib + matrix 0 failed. This is the deletion fz-go4.17.10 claimed.

comments.text:
INVESTIGATION (no commit; STOPPED for authorization — the deletion cascades beyond scope into a live CLI feature + 64 real tests).

CLEANLY DELETABLE (zero production consumers, proven; native confirmed off the spine — rg native.rs for transport_plan/SemanticClosed/SemanticReady/root_executable_frontier/executable_transport = nothing): Job::DeriveExecutableTransport, Job::DeriveTransportPlan, Job::DeriveRuntimeDemand, Job::SealSemanticClosure + arms; FactKey::ExecutableTransport, TransportPlan, SemanticReady, SemanticClosed; world.transport_plan/define/remove + TransportPlanMap + executable_transport store; root_executable_frontier (+ its sole fact_keys scan); forbidden_product_path_job (compiler.rs:449, backend.rs:215, +2 test copies) + drive_root_to's Semantic arm.

HIDDEN-SURPRISE CASCADE (not in ticket list, but required for -D warnings): FactKey::RuntimeDemand + world.runtime_demand store + define_runtime_demand become legacy-only after deletion (product path uses session.memo().runtime_demand exclusively; world store read only by seal/derive_runtime_demand/legacy transport/define_semantic_closure). In-scope for deletion.

DECISION 1 — DumpStage::Semantic is a LIVE CLI consumer: fz2 build --dump types|activations -> required_stage Semantic (dump.rs:59) -> drive_root_to(SealSemanticClosure) (compiler.rs:182) -> seal -> define_semantic_closure -> emit_semantic_dump_events (world.rs:1201). cli.rs:337. The dump data is per-activation facts but the activation SET comes only from the seal's SemanticClosure -> cannot be served without the spine absent a new product-path activation enumerator. Options: (A) delete the types/activations dump kinds + DumpStage::Semantic + emit_semantic_dump_events + SemanticClosure store, file a re-serve-from-product follow-up; (B) build the product-path enumerator now (feature, scope creep).

DECISION 2 — BLOCKER: deleting world.transport_plan makes transport_contract_test.rs (4944 lines, 64 tests) uncompilable (they drive legacy DeriveTransportPlan via drive_until_transport_plan and assert world.transport_plan shape/lane/boundary contracts); semantic_analysis_test.rs (18 refs) + drive_test.rs (43 refs) also affected. The 'keep 941/0' gate is impossible alongside the mandated deletion. Options: (A) delete the legacy-plan tests + file a ticket to port the fine-grained contract assertions onto the product TransportPlan (session_transport_plan); execution-level coverage remains via drive_test + fixture matrix; contract-granularity coverage temporarily drops. (B) retarget the 64 tests to the product TransportPlan now (preserves coverage, larger error-prone migration). (C) PORT-FIRST sequencing: do the port (dump + 64 tests -> product path) as a prerequisite ticket, THEN delete the spine cleanly (correct-by-construction: migrate consumers before deleting). 

Recommendation under discussion with owner before execution.

title: Delete the legacy seal/transport spine after native cutover
